source_fields.formulation: Action centers lie in a convex set with public mirror geometry, and losses are globally Euclidean Lipschitz. Each round reveals exact values of the same function on opposite sides of the center; only the center incurs loss. Dual-norm moments of spherical directions control the gradient-estimator variance.
source_fields.solution_goal: Minimize performance as defined by the metric, guarantee, and native resource.

source_fields.instance: The compact convex center-action set $W\subset\mathbb R^d$, norm $\|\cdot\|$, and its dual are public. The regularizer $\psi$ is $1$-strongly convex in that norm and satisfies $$0\le\psi(x)\le R_\psi^2\quad(x\in W),\qquad p_*\ge\left(\mathbb E_{u\sim\operatorname{Unif}(\mathbb S^{d-1})}\|u\|_*^4\right)^{1/4}.$$. All losses are fixed before interaction, convex on all of $\mathbb R^d$, and $G_2$-Lipschitz in the Euclidean norm.

operations.query_signature: $$f_t(x_t+\rho_tu_t),\qquad f_t(x_t-\rho_tu_t).$$ Both evaluations use the same current function without measurement noise, and are revealed after the probes are submitted. The center satisfies $x_t\in W$; probes may lie outside $W$ because losses are defined on the whole space. Loss is incurred only at the center $x_t$. Causal learners keep centers feasible. Inputs $W,\psi,\|\cdot\|,G_2,R_\psi,p_*,T$ are public, and one mirror/proximal update is allowed per round. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

source_fields.feasibility: The output is the complete action trajectory satisfying feasibility and timing requirements. Randomized mixtures may be implemented before acting. Retrospective averages or convex combinations cannot replace actions that have already incurred loss. No additional optimal value or certificate is required.
source_fields.allowed_postprocessing: Previously executed online actions cannot be changed.
source_fields.certificate_requirement: No function value, optimality certificate, or final recommendation is required unless explicitly listed for this axis.

source_fields.base_expression: $$R_T=\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(w_t)-\min_{w\in W}\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(w).$$ Only the feasible center incurs loss; losses at the two exact-value probes are not added.
source_fields.normalization: Use the cumulative quantity over T rounds without dividing by T. Preserve the displayed order of probability or expectation.
source_fields.finiteness_conditions: The center domain W is compact and therefore has finite Euclidean diameter. Loss differences between centers are bounded by G_2 times that diameter.
